title: senior-mode project configuration (.claude/senior-mode.json)
description: The configuration of a project that uses senior-mode. `senior-mode config validate` (run by `check` and `doctor`) reads this file: it understands type, enum, minimum, maximum, pattern, properties, additionalProperties, items, deprecated, x-replacedBy and x-deprecatedValues.

minVersion.description: The oldest senior-mode that reads this file. A plugin older than this reports one version mismatch (update the plugin) instead of one error per key it does not know.

language.description: Language of the templates and of what Claude writes for you.

lsp.description: The answer to the language server proposal of setup: `true` when you enable it in Claude Code, `false` when you decline. Any value stops the proposal.

commands.description: Commands of the preset (lint, typecheck, test, build, e2e, format, install).

packages.description: The packages of a monorepo, by directory, written by `setup repo` from the manifests (npm, pnpm and yarn workspaces, Cargo workspace, Go modules). Their commands run in their directory; `install` runs once at the root, except for Go, once per module. `check` runs only the packages the diff affects and their dependents (`check --all` runs every package).

preset.description: The preset of the package (node, go, rust).

deps.description: Directories of the packages it depends on.

checks.description: The check list, run in order.

changed.description: The command `check --changed` runs on the changed files only; {files} stands for them.

fix.description: The command that fixes what the check reports; a failure prints it as `fix: <command>`.

inputs.description: Globs of the tracked files the check reads. With them, a success is cached by the content of those files, the configuration and the lockfiles, and the next run skips the check as `ok <name> (cached)`; `check --no-cache` runs it anyway.

since.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the check was added: a failure only warns for `check.warnDays` days after it, then blocks. `setup repo` stamps it on the checks it adds to a project that already had some. The secret scan and the dependency audit never take one.

tier.description: When the check runs: 2 (default) at every push, 3 in the heavy run (`check --tier 3`, `check --all`).

edit.description: Tier 1 fixers (formatter, lint --fix) run on the file the agent just wrote, `{file}` standing for its quoted path. They never block: at most 10 unfixed findings go back to the agent.

warnDays.description: Days a check with a `since` only warns when it fails, before it blocks (default 14).

command.description: The benchmark command: it writes a JSON object of benchmark name to median to the file `{out}` stands for, or prints it. A hot path of a spec must name a benchmark, and tier 3 compares the benchmarks of the hot paths a diff touches with the base.

threshold.description: Percent a benchmark may be slower than on the base branch before tier 3 fails it (default 10).

linter.description: The linter `check` runs on the migrations the branch adds or changes: `squawk` (Postgres), `django-migration-linter`; a Django project (a `manage.py` at the root) gets the second one. With none, `check` says `migrations: not measured`.

paths.description: Globs of the migrations the linter reads (default `**/migrations/**/*.sql`, or `**/migrations/*.py` for Django).

helper.description: Path of the query-count helper of the project's ORM (Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Django, sqlx), written by `setup repo`; journey tests assert a query count that does not grow with the list.

protected.description: Globs of protected zones. Layers add to it, none removes from it.

secrets.description: Extra globs of the secrets guard. Layers add to it.

audit.description: false turns off the dependency audit of `check`.

wip.description: Open tickets In progress at once (default 3).

slot.description: A shell command that derives the environment of a session slot.

slotDown.description: A shell command, idempotent, that tears down the environment of a session slot (run before the session, after it, whatever the exit).

slotUp.description: A shell command that brings up the environment of a session slot, after slotDown and before the session.

workflow.description: What setup repo detected of the project's workflow; absent, senior-mode's defaults apply.

integration.description: The branch tickets start from and their pull requests target.

link.description: The keyword that links the issue, or none.

protection.description: Written by setup github: ruleset, local (GitHub refused the ruleset: senior-mode gates the merge and audits pushes) or none (no merge on its own).

requiredChecks.description: false keeps setup github from adding required status checks to the ruleset.

previews.description: Hosted preview deployments (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages) of the branches senior-mode pushes: platform leaves them to the platform, ready deploys one preview per pull request once senior-mode preview asks, off deploys none.

paths.description: Globs of the files of the user interface: a pull request whose diff touches one is a UI pull request (so is one whose ticket is labelled ui), and a ticket whose Paths reach one is predicted UI by ready. setup repo writes them from the preset and never overwrites a set value.

url.description: Template of the preview URL of a UI pull request, with {{pr}}, {{branch}}, {{sha}} and {{slug}} (the branch as lower case letters, digits and -). Shown only when one curl of it answers 2xx or 3xx.

viewports.description: Viewports senior-mode shots renders each route at (default 390x844 and 1280x800).

baseUrl.description: The before site of the screenshots (production or staging); without it preview.command runs on the merge base.

command.description: Command that serves the app for the screenshots, run in a slot; {{port}} is the PORT of the slot environment.

maxKB.description: Largest screenshot pushed, in kilobytes (default 400); larger ones are scaled down with magick or convert.

public.description: Push the screenshots of a public repository to senior-mode/shots (default false).

waitSeconds.description: Seconds publish waits, polling every 15, for a successful GitHub deployment status with an environment_url on the head commit when preview.url is not set (default 300).

minPackageAgeDays.description: A new dependency fails check when its package was first published fewer days ago.

minWeeklyDownloads.description: A new dependency fails check when its package had fewer downloads last week.

claudeMdLines.description: Most lines a tracked CLAUDE.md may have before check fails.

budget.description: Tokens (bytes / 4) the session briefing may take; the router and the ticket are never dropped.

repoMapTokens.description: Tokens (bytes / 4) of the repo map of the session briefing, inside context.budget; the default is 400.

project.description: The Project board; written by setup github.

home.description: owner/name of the repository that holds the duties of a Project shared by several repositories; written by setup github --project.

iteration.description: An Iteration field, cached by setup github.

date.description: A date field (Start, End), cached by setup github.

enforce.description: Whether a ticket with no parent epic, or whose epic's milestone has no Goal: line, is refused by the Definition of Ready and left out by pick.

exempt.description: Labels of the tickets that need no parent epic (default security and hotfix).

maxLines.description: Most lines of the body of a note in docs/knowledge.

staleMonths.description: Months after which a note's verified date makes the briefing call it stale.

churnCommits.description: Commits on a note's paths since its verified date above which serve files a gardening ticket to re-verify it.

maxNotes.description: Most knowledge notes (risk zones included) the adoption survey writes into its pull request; the rest are listed.

maxAdrs.description: Most retroactive ADRs the adoption survey writes.

maxRules.description: Most architecture rules the adoption survey adds to architecture.rules.

share.description: Share of autonomy.parallel slots serve keeps for Ready gardening tickets (ceil of share times parallel); 0 reserves none.

maxOpen.description: Most open gardening tickets: serve files no more while that many are open.

debt.description: Turns the legacy debt of the baselines into gardening tickets: set by setup repo --adopt --debt, then serve files the next ranked ticket when one closes, within maxOpen. Needs adopt.kind legacy.

n.description: Candidates tried for a ticket whose pull request still has changes requested after 2 fix rounds, the pull request being the first: serve starts the others on branches -b2 and -b3, one at a time; the first whose review passes merges and the others are closed. 1 (the default) turns it off.

repeat.description: Tickets with the same cause on the same paths or skill, in the period, that make retro open an improvement ticket.

rules.description: Rules `check` enforces: an id and exactly one of forbidImport, maxLines or banned.

paths.description: Globs of the files a maxLines or banned rule reads.

packs.description: Rule packs `check` runs on the diff (plugins/senior-mode/rules/<pack>.json); the preset's when absent (`setup repo` writes the preset's quality pack there); `common` is always added.

off.description: Rules turned off, by rule id, each with its reason; with `paths` the rule is skipped only under them.

shared.description: Globs of the folders that hold the shared code; the first one is where `check` says to extract a third copy of a block.

envModule.description: Globs of the files allowed to read the environment (the scattered-env rule); the preset's when absent.

command.description: Lint command whose output the ratchet reads: ESLint, ruff, golangci-lint or clippy JSON, or a list of {file, rule, line}.

report.description: Path of the lcov or Cobertura report the ratchet reads.
Directory of the axe reports the ratchet reads, one JSON file per journey (default test-results/a11y).

patchCoverage.description: Percent of lines a new file must cover.

diffLines.description: Changed-line budget of a pull request by Size.

diffWeights.description: How much a changed line of a test file or of a documentation file weighs against limits.diffLines (code weighs 1).

diffExclude.description: Globs of the files the size budget does not count at all (generated or fixture data).

maxTickets.description: Tickets per run. 0 (the default) means no cap.

parallel.description: Tickets worked on at once, and the number of session slots (default 3).

maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Failed tickets in a row after which the circuit breaker opens (default 3).

merge.description: Whether a pull request that passes every bound is merged (default true; false stops at the reviewed pull request).

sessionTimeout.description: Minutes. A value a project sets applies to every Size; unset, autonomy.sessionTimeoutBySize decides (the default shown is the M one).

sessionTimeoutBySize.description: Minutes a ticket session may run, by Size, when autonomy.sessionTimeout is not set: S 45, M 120, L 240.

ticketsPerHour.description: Tickets serve begins in any 60 minutes. 0 (the default) means no limit.

startupSeconds.description: Seconds after which a session that died at once counts as a startup death.

startupMinutes.description: Minutes of nothing at all after which the watchdog stops a session.

stallMinutes.description: Minutes without any change after which the watchdog stops a session.

userSettings.description: Whether run and serve sessions load the owner's user-level Claude Code configuration.

callTimeout.description: Seconds a gh call of serve may take.

unknownBackoffMax.description: Minutes, the longest wait before serve retries a ticket whose session ended on an unknown environment failure (1, 2, 4... minutes).

pendingReviewHours.description: Hours after which a pull request behind its base, whose review is pending for a human merge, gets a fresh review.

unknownMaxAttempts.description: Launches of a ticket that ends on an unknown environment failure, with nothing changed, before it is needs-human.

minReleaseDays.description: Days a version must have been published before a Dependabot pull request that bumps it is ready to merge (default 7, or the workspace's own minimumReleaseAge when the project sets one).

sharedPaths.description: Root files that parallel tickets each add to (package.json, README.md, a lockfile): a conflict on one is merged additively, or regenerated for a lockfile.

allow.description: Hosts a sandboxed session may reach besides the model API and the registries of the preset: an exact host, or *.suffix for any subdomain (not the apex).

verbs.description: Extra read-only gh verbs a sandboxed session may run through the credential broker, as `gh <group> <view|list|status|diff|checks>`. A write verb, `gh auth`, `gh repo`, `gh api` and the secret and key groups are refused.

network.description: The network of a container: allowlist (default) an internal network whose only way out is the filtering proxy; none no network; open the bridge network, no proxy (status warns).

mode.description: Whether a session runs in a container: auto uses one when a runtime and a model credential exist, else the host; required holds every launch (cause sandbox) when it cannot; off never.

runtime.description: The container runtime: auto finds podman (rootless, the reference), then docker.

image.description: An image for sessions; empty builds .senior-mode/Dockerfile, else the plugin's base.

credentialFile.description: File (mode 0600) with the model credential of containers, lines NAME=value with NAME matching ANTHROPIC_* or CLAUDE_CODE_* (the token of claude setup-token; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is never accepted).

digestAt.description: Local time (HH:MM) after which serve sends the daily digest to the notify webhook; off when empty.

coAuthor.description: Whether the commits of run and serve sessions may carry Claude Code's Co-Authored-By trailer; false empties attribution.commit for the sessions and makes check refuse a branch whose commits carry one.

below.description: Coverage percent (ratchet baseline) under which an existing file counts as untested: a branch that changes it needs a characterization commit first.

exempt.description: Globs of files that need no characterization commit, on top of docs, tests, generated files, types and constants.

process.description: The process: the profile (a file, see profile.schema.json) and the lifts of its locked gates. Read from the repository layer; a profile or a lift in another layer is ignored for the lifts.

profile.description: `fast` (default) or `strict`, or a profile file of the project under .claude/senior-mode/profiles/.

lifts.description: One entry per locked gate that the profile lifts, with the accepted ADR of this repository that decided it.

adr.description: Path of the ADR from the repository root, for instance docs/adr/0016-this-repository-delivery.md.

required.description: Whether a selected journey of an accepted spec must have its test file with the journey id in it (default true); false makes a missing test a warning.

org.description: The organization layer (#400): read from the repository and local layers only, never from the organization itself.

inherit.description: false turns off the read of the organization layer (default true).

repo.description: Repository of the owner that holds the organization layer (default .github).

path.description: Directory of that repository that holds it (default senior-mode).

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit of the organization layer to read, to pin it; empty reads the default branch.
